say.speaker: mentor
say.text: Eyes up, all three of you! Tonight we drill the fundamentals of tactical combat right here on the village pitch.

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: First lesson: spacing and enemy reach. {partner}, step forward into my attack range so you can feel how an opponent closes in!

say.speaker: partner
say.text: You got it, Dad! Watch my footwork, {lord}, {healer}!
